empty.title: No properties match
empty.filtered: Loosen the filters or switch tab — your database is bigger than this view.
empty.none: Start by importing your first property from MyHome.ge.

details.deleteConfirmBody: It moves to Recently Deleted and can be restored for 30 days.

sourceListing.title: Source listing
sourceListing.hint: Where this property was found — the owner's or another agent's advert, not your own.
sourceListing.noLink: No link saved for this listing.

published.title: My published listings
published.hintMine: Your own adverts. Publish from here, or add the IDs of adverts you posted yourself.
published.notYet: Not published by you on MyHome.ge or SS.ge yet.

details.sharedPrivacy: Owner name, phone and private notes stay with {{name}}. Agree the split directly before you offer it to a client.

owner.title: Owner & contact
owner.noNotes: No notes yet. Write down what the owner said on the phone — it is the part you forget first.

sent.empty: This property hasn't been sent to anyone yet.

photos.label: Property photos
photos.skipped_one: {{count}} file skipped — JPG, PNG or WEBP only
photos.skipped_other: {{count}} files skipped — JPG, PNG or WEBP only
photos.removedNotDeleted: Photo removed here, but couldn't delete it from storage
photos.upload: Upload photos — or drop them here
photos.note: JPG, PNG or WEBP · up to {{max}} photos · the first one is the cover shown everywhere.

portal.pairNeedsUrl: Add the listing URL too — you'll want to open it when a caller quotes this ID.
portal.pairNeedsId: Add the listing ID as well, so callers quoting it find this property.

picker.placeholder: Listing ID, address or district — e.g. 1945621

gallery.emptyHint: Properties you type in by hand start empty. Imported listings bring their photos with them.

import.title: Import property
import.subtitle: Paste a listing link or ID. Agent OS reads the public details; you add the private half after the owner call.
import.pickPortal: Pick a portal above — a listing number on its own doesn't say which site it came from.

errors.invalid_input: That doesn't look like a listing link or ID. Paste the full URL, or the listing number with a portal selected.
errors.unsupported_source: Agent OS can't import from that site yet. MyHome.ge and SS.ge are supported.
errors.service_unavailable: Importing needs the AgentOS extension. Install or update it, make sure it's switched on, then try again.
errors.not_found: That listing wasn't found on the portal. It may have been removed.
errors.unknown: There was a server-side error, try again.

duplicate.title: This listing has already been imported

preview.title: Import preview
preview.noImages: No images found on this listing.

stillNeeds.title: Still needs you — after the owner call
stillNeeds.body: A public advert can't say who is really selling or what they'll pay you, so the property saves as "needs verification" with the private side left unconfirmed.

supported.title: Supported sources
supported.viaService: Listings are read through the AgentOS extension, in your own browser.
supported.noService: Portals block direct browser requests, so live fetching runs through an import service you host. Until one is connected, only the two sample links resolve — and they are clearly marked as simulated.

extension.title: Browser extension
extension.body: AgentOS uses its browser extension to import from and publish to MyHome.ge and SS.ge with your own accounts.

why.title: Why import beats typing
why.importTime: About 20 seconds, then the owner call
